LESSON: ZAKAT AND ZAKATUL FITR

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Zakat and Zakatul Fitr

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Zakat and Zakatul Fitr. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to pay Zakat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim
2. identify items exempted from Zakat payment
3. appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ZAKAT AND ZAKATUL FITR
This lesson teaches Zakat and Zakatul Fitr for Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. identify items exempted from Zakat payment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Zakat and Zakatul Fitr using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Zakat and Zakatul Fitr above.
2. Explain Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Zakat and Zakatul Fitr important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to pay Zakat?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim
2. identify items exempted from Zakat payment
3. appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
